purpose: Source-Faithfulness Eval v2 / Fake-Geometry Gate + EGSR triage over known artifacts.

scope.source_scope: Current Waymo2Panorama repo artifacts/calibration/ROIs only; do not generalize AV2 assumptions automatically.

claim_label_definitions.source-faithful: Pixels/operation remain source-derived with explicit caveats for residual risk.
claim_label_definitions.caveated-handoff: Bosch-facing candidate with explicit non-source/generated/source-sidestep caveats.
claim_label_definitions.source-sidestep: Accepted only as source/frame selection; not local repair of the original seam.
claim_label_definitions.presentation-only: May be shown as visual/demo output only with generated/edit masks.
claim_label_definitions.generated: Contains generated content and is not sensor truth.
claim_label_definitions.diagnostic: Failure/reference/control case; not a production base.
claim_label_definitions.abstain: Current evidence does not justify source-faithful repair.
claim_label_definitions.reject: Fails gate or vision verdict; do not continue this direction without new brief/evidence.

cases.title: DB32 s40 current handoff
cases.vision_verdict: Use as Bosch-facing presentation/handoff candidate with caveats; not fully source-faithful and not a G/A1/BEST repair.
cases.next_action: Keep as current handoff candidate; expose generated sky/source-sidestep masks in later DB49.

cases.title: DB34 DB32 source preservation QA
cases.vision_verdict: Positive control for DB32 non-core source pixels: buildings, road, vehicles, and skyline are byte-exact outside generated sky core.
cases.next_action: Use as source-preservation control only; it does not make the full DB32 panorama fully source-faithful.

cases.title: DB32 top sky generated/captured mix
cases.vision_verdict: Generated sky can be accepted only with explicit caveat and mask; residual captured-sky panel remains visible.
cases.next_action: Keep as sky-only/generated control; do not transfer acceptance logic to ground/curb/lane.

cases.title: DB32 long seam ROI
cases.vision_verdict: Cleaner than classic G because the source base changed; cannot be claimed as a repaired original-G seam.
cases.next_action: Use only with source-sidestep language.

cases.title: DB28 a200 source long ROI
cases.vision_verdict: Accepted as better source candidate; still not proof that a local seam was repaired.
cases.next_action: Feed only source-selection or data-contract branches.

cases.title: BEV/seamroute source-faithful ceiling
cases.segment_type: T3 planar road + T5 curb floor
cases.operator: O4 BEV road atlas + source-only seamroute
cases.vision_verdict: Source-faithful ceiling for the current BMW-style route: road can improve, curb/out-of-FOV remains bounded.
cases.next_action: Use as positive/caveated control for DB44, not as proof that DB41 right-line is repairable.

cases.title: G_bmw_pano long seam
cases.vision_verdict: Classic BMW failure / diagnostic reference; visually judged unsuitable as default repair base.
cases.next_action: Do not use as default base; only compare against it.

cases.title: G_bmw_pano right-line
cases.vision_verdict: Right-line/curb region remains visibly wrong and is not repairable under current DB41 evidence.
cases.next_action: Abstain unless a new evidence brief changes DB41.

cases.title: A1_view_none right ROI
cases.vision_verdict: Smoother in places but still not accepted as long/right seam repair.
cases.next_action: Use for mask-alignment diagnosis only.

cases.title: BEST right ROI
cases.vision_verdict: Ghosted source/donor candidate; unsafe as production repair source.
cases.next_action: Do not use as donor unless a future brief proves otherwise.

cases.title: DB19 G sky-only
cases.vision_verdict: Sky-only generated output can be useful, but classic G ground/right seam remains.
cases.next_action: Keep generated sky masked; do not claim seam repair.

cases.title: DB23 ground outpaint
cases.vision_verdict: Detector-clean output invents lower road/lane/curb geometry; not Bosch training data.
cases.next_action: Do not reopen prompt-only ground outpaint.

cases.title: DB23 full outpaint
cases.vision_verdict: Full outpaint fails object gate and generates broad non-source scene content.
cases.next_action: Keep as negative generated-control only.

cases.title: DB36 user red-line DiT
cases.vision_verdict: Ultra-narrow mask preserved outside pixels and passed object gate, but generated fake ground slabs/holes.
cases.next_action: Do not tune prompt-only right-line/curb masks.

cases.title: DB39 G v14 raw
cases.vision_verdict: Existing exact v14 G replay introduces a right-side vertical generated slice/pole-like artifact.
cases.next_action: Do not rerun same v14 matrix without new source/depth constraints.

cases.title: DB39 BEST v14 raw
cases.vision_verdict: Inherits BEST ghosting and adds slab/slice artifacts; object gate fails.
cases.next_action: Keep as negative donor/v14 control.

cases.title: DB39 A1 v14 raw
cases.vision_verdict: Turns A1 right seam into a visible vertical slice; supports DB40 mask/source mismatch diagnosis.
cases.next_action: Use for diagnosis only.

cases.title: DB40 A1 keepout
cases.vision_verdict: Explains and locally reduces the A1 right-BMW slab, but leaves visible vertical edit bands.
cases.next_action: Use as root-cause evidence, not final repair.

cases.title: DB40 A1 longsrc raw
cases.vision_verdict: Narrower long-source mask produces a conspicuous pole-like vertical object despite object-gate PASS.
cases.next_action: Stop v14 A1/G route unless new evidence appears.

cases.title: DB35 BEST donor patch
cases.vision_verdict: BEST donor barely changes the line and carries ghost risk.
cases.next_action: Do not use BEST donor patching as production repair.

cases.title: DB35 A1 donor patch
cases.vision_verdict: A1 donor softens/blurs lower-right ground and still does not straighten the seam.
cases.next_action: Do not use A1 donor patching as production repair.

cases.title: DB25 long-line evidence
cases.vision_verdict: Long-line ROI lacks reliable full-line correspondence; geometry warp should abstain.
cases.next_action: Do not repair without stronger raw/depth/correspondence evidence.

cases.title: DB24 long-line source-boundary diagnosis
cases.vision_verdict: Explains why Google/Meta-style repair is blocked: the line is a source/camera-id boundary through near-ground/dark-wall low-texture content.
cases.next_action: Use as production-mechanism abstain control.

cases.title: DB26 photometric attenuation
cases.vision_verdict: Even source-safe low-frequency attenuation fails the seam claim and risks dark-wall color wash/smudge.
cases.next_action: Do not accept source-safe color edits unless the vision gate passes.

cases.title: DB41 right ROI
cases.vision_verdict: Flow has local reliable patches but LiDAR support is too sparse for continuous white-line/curb repair.
cases.next_action: Keep DB41 boundary until new evidence changes it.

cases.title: DB41 lower-right ROI
cases.vision_verdict: All near-ground ROI has zero LiDAR support on the actual target surface; source-faithful repair must abstain.
cases.next_action: Mandatory negative control for DB44.

cases.title: DB30 sky-panel mask
cases.segment_type: T8 sky mask with foreground bleed
cases.vision_verdict: Rejected before DiT because automatic sky-panel mask included buildings/vehicle/road-adjacent pixels.
cases.next_action: Do not generate through polluted sky masks.

cases.title: DB33 local sky s50
cases.vision_verdict: Source pixels are preserved, but local sky halos/diagonal bands make it worse than DB32.
cases.next_action: Keep rectilinear review; do not continue local color-field tuning.

cases.title: DB31 relaxed scan failures
cases.vision_verdict: Bounded scan did not find a better non-BMW successor; useful as source-selection accounting.
cases.next_action: Future DB47 must report acceptance/reject statistics, not only pretty examples.

rectilinear_controls.title: DB22 rectilinear right-line diagnostic
rectilinear_controls.verdict: Mask placement was not the root problem; DiT ground/curb semantics redraws fake geometry.

rectilinear_controls.title: DB33 rectilinear sky review
rectilinear_controls.verdict: Rectilinear review catches sky halos/bands that ERP can hide.

rectilinear_controls.title: DB36 reject review
rectilinear_controls.verdict: Object gate PASS is insufficient when seam-local fake slabs/holes appear.

rectilinear_controls.title: DB40 longsrc reject review
rectilinear_controls.verdict: Narrow mask still hallucinates pole-like vertical geometry.

gate_checks.name: DB32 is not fully source-faithful
gate_checks.detail: DB32 must remain Bosch-facing handoff with source-sidestep + generated-sky caveats.

gate_checks.name: DB41 right-line/lower-right abstains
gate_checks.detail: Right-line and lower-right must not be marked repairable under current evidence.

gate_checks.name: Known fake geometry is rejected
gate_checks.detail: DB23/DB36/DB39/DB40 style fake road/slab/slice/pole artifacts cannot pass.

gate_checks.name: Reason codes are mandatory
gate_checks.detail: Every case carries reason codes; no scalar-only verdict.

gate_checks.name: Generated sky and generated ground are separated
gate_checks.detail: Sky-only generated caveat is not treated like fake generated ground/curb/lane.

gate_checks.name: G_bmw_pano is not a default repair base
gate_checks.detail: G is only a classic BMW failure / diagnostic reference.

red_team_audit: Smoothness is never a pass condition by itself; generated road/curb/lane artifacts stay rejected even when object gate passes.
DB32 is deliberately caveated: handoff candidate, source-sidestep, generated sky; not source-faithful ceiling.
G/A1/BEST cases remain diagnostic or rejected unless a future brief brings new evidence and survives its kill criteria.
DB44 cannot start by repairing DB41 RED regions; it must first prove abstain behavior on those controls.
Any brief that hits kill criteria must stop and be archived to progress.md instead of continuing parameter patches.
db44_preconditions: DB32 remains caveated-handoff, not fully source-faithful.
DB44 starts as layer/evidence/operator dispatcher dry run; no diffusion and no RED-region repair.
